# Nader Alzghoul (نادر الزغول)

> Nader Alzghoul is a QA Automation Engineer in Amman, Jordan. He tests, teaches, volunteers and delivers, and builds free open-source tools. This site is his portfolio, in English and Arabic.

- [Portfolio](https://nj-burrito.github.io/): about, work, projects, latest LinkedIn posts
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/nader-alzghoul)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/NJ-Burrito)

## Projects

- [Profile-Wrap](https://nj-burrito.github.io/Profile-Wrap/): free, open-source LinkedIn post manager and scheduler. Nothing goes out until you tap Allow. Source: https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/Profile-Wrap
- [NJ-Kit](https://nj-burrito.github.io/NJ-Kit/): Claude Code plugin with one working method and 40 skills, each ending in a PASS or FAIL gate. Source: https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/NJ-Kit
- [QA Wrap](https://nj-burrito.github.io/QA-Wrap/): browser extension that turns a manual test session into a bug report, Arabic and English. Source: https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/QA-Wrap
- [Shalwa Automation Project](https://github.com/NJ-Burrito/Shalwa-Automation-Project-SAP-): Java, Selenium, Maven and JUnit test automation

## Facts

- Role: QA Automation Engineer at TaqneenSoft, Amman, Jordan.
- Delivered QA work for 100+ government e-services on two portals (JFDA and MOA): Playwright tests, SRS documents, bilingual manuals.
- Teaches: learners aged 8 to 32, including AI and robotics for students aged 8 to 16.
- Languages: Arabic (native), English (strong), Spanish (learning).
- Contact: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nader-alzghoul
